page_title: CRO 4-1 CAN | Croatia v Canada 27/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' 4 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Lovro Majer (Croatia), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 4:1.

90+3' Junior Hoilett (Canada) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Croatia will have a goal kick.
90+3' Junior Hoilett (Canada) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+3' Alphonso Davies (Canada) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+2' Lovro Majer (Croatia) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Steven Vitoria (Canada) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andres Matias Matonte Cabrera blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Alistair Johnston (Canada) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' A pass finds the feet of Mislav Orsic (Croatia) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mateo Kovacic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lovro Majer (Croatia).
86' Zlatko Dalic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Pasalic (Croatia) replacing Luka Modric.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mislav Orsic (Croatia) replaces Ivan Perisic.
85' Luka Modric (Croatia) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
85' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Kamal Miller (Canada) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
81' The attendance is 44374.
81' Lucas Cavallini (Canada) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
79' Marcelo Brozovic (Croatia) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Milan Borjan is alert and denies him.

79' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom left corner, but Milan Borjan makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.

77' A pass out of defence finds Junior Hoilett (Canada) in space, he doesn't think twice and releases a shot from long range which flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Croatia.
75' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) works the corner short.
74' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Tajon Buchanan (Canada) heads on.
72' Zlatko Dalic prepares a substitution. Andrej Kramaric is replaced by Nikola Vlasic (Croatia).
72' It will be a substitution. Sam Adekugbe (Canada) is ready to enter the pitch as Atiba Hutchinson walks off.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonathan David trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lucas Cavallini (Canada).
72' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andres Matias Matonte Cabrera blows for a foul.

70' 3 - 1 Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) meets a perfect cross from Ivan Perisic deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 3:1.
69' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Milan Borjan comes off the line to clear the ball away.
68' Alphonso Davies (Canada) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
66' A pass from Josko Gvardiol (Croatia) is intercepted by Milan Borjan and the move breaks down.
63' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Alphonso Davies (Canada) on the edge of the box.
63' Canada win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
62' Josko Gvardiol (Croatia) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
62' John Herdman decides to make a substitution. Richie Laryea will be replaced by Junior Hoilett (Canada).
60' Here's the change. Marko Livaja leaves the pitch and Bruno Petkovic (Croatia) comes on as a substitute.
59' The ball is cleared after Tajon Buchanan (Canada) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

58' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Milan Borjan, who smothers the ball.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Canada.
56' Andres Matias Matonte Cabrera shows a yellow card to Dejan Lovren (Croatia) for his blatant foul.

56' A sweet pass finds Jonathan David (Canada) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Dominik Livakovic is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball goes out of play. Canada are awarded a corner kick.
55' Luka Modric (Croatia) commits a rough foul. Andres Matias Matonte Cabrera stops the game and makes a call.
55' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

54' A pass into the box finds Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Milan Borjan denies him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Croatia are going to take it.
53' Josip Juranovic (Croatia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tajon Buchanan (Canada) was quite harsh and Andres Matias Matonte Cabrera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Borna Sosa (Croatia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Milan Borjan intercepts the ball.
51' Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

50' Marko Livaja (Croatia) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
49' Fine attempt! Jonathan Osorio (Canada) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
49' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
47' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andres Matias Matonte Cabrera saw the whole situation.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) comes off for Ismael Kone.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. John Herdman gives a chance to Jonathan Osorio and Cyle Larin (Canada) is off.
46' The whistle blows and Andres Matias Matonte Cabrera starts the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+5' A cross into the box from Ivan Perisic (Croatia) is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Croatia have been awarded a corner kick.

45+2' A short pass finds Andrej Kramaric (Croatia). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.

44' 2 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Marko Livaja (Croatia) and Josip Juranovic gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 2:1.
44' Richie Laryea (Canada) is flagged for offside.
42' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.

39' Half-chance! Ivan Perisic (Croatia) plays a pass into the box, but Milan Borjan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
39' Alphonso Davies (Canada) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
36' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Ivan Perisic laid the ball off to Andrej Kramaric (Croatia), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
36' Luka Modric (Croatia) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

35' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Marko Livaja (Croatia) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Milan Borjan pulls off an easy save. The referee blows his whistle, Croatia are awarded a corner kick.
35' Luka Modric (Croatia) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

26' A goal, which was scored by Andrej Kramaric (Croatia), was disallowed due to offside.
23' Alistair Johnston (Canada) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
22' Marko Livaja (Croatia) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Milan Borjan.
22' Borna Sosa (Croatia) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
21' Alphonso Davies (Canada) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
19' Stephen Eustaquio (Canada) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
19' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Canada earn a corner.
18' Wonderful pass from Cyle Larin (Canada) for Tajon Buchanan, but they can't profit from it as Dominik Livakovic comes off his line to collect.
17' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
17' Borna Sosa (Croatia) serves up a nice cross, but Milan Borjan punches the ball away.
15' Cyle Larin (Canada) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
14' Borna Sosa (Croatia) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Andres Matias Matonte Cabrera blows his whistle for an infringement.
12' Luka Modric (Croatia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

8' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

4' Richie Laryea (Canada) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
